video_title: Hornets at Pistons: Coach Charles Lee Postgame Media Availability | 10/28/2026

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on Pistons' defensive pressure and Hornets' turnovers
quotes.excerpt: they ratcheted up their defensive pressure a little bit, their physicality, and unfortunately had too many costly turnovers

text_blocks.speaker: Shannon
text_blocks.text: Take me back to the start of the second half because that's really when the Pistons took control of this game. Where were some of the breakdowns that you saw?

text_blocks.speaker: Charles Lee
text_blocks.text: They ratcheted up their defensive pressure a little bit, their physicality, and unfortunately had too many costly turnovers or slow possessions. But I do love the overall fighting competitiveness of the group. To hold a good team like that to 97 points on the road shows the competitive spirit, the defensive intensity that we had. And then offensively, I thought that we just made one too many mistakes and they punished us for it.

quotes.social_post: Charles Lee credited the Hornets defensive intensity for holding the Pistons to 97 points but noted that too many costly turnovers and slow possessions ultimately cost them the game.

structured.context: Charles Lee discusses the Pistons' defensive pressure and the Hornets' turnovers during the second half of the game.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on benching Naz Reid for the second half
quotes.excerpt: Naz didn't meet our standards in the first half and at halftime we made a decision

text_blocks.speaker: Shannon
text_blocks.text: We didn't see Naz Reid play in the second. Can you tell us what went behind that decision?

text_blocks.speaker: Charles Lee
text_blocks.text: Unfortunately, Naz didn't meet our standards in the first half and at halftime we made a decision that he wouldn't play in the second half, but I look forward to him meeting those standards come next game.

quotes.social_post: Charles Lee confirmed Naz Reid was benched for the entire second half because he did not meet our standards in the first half.

structured.context: Charles Lee explains the decision to bench Naz Reid for the entire second half due to failing to meet team standards.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on defensive effort against Cade Cunningham
quotes.excerpt: the pressure on Cunningham was really good. For us to hold him to 30 points

text_blocks.speaker: Shannon
text_blocks.text: When you look at it from start to finish, outside of just the fight, what else did you see?

text_blocks.speaker: Charles Lee
text_blocks.text: The pressure on Cunningham was really good. For us to hold him to 30 points, I thought that a lot of those buckets he had to work for and he was trying to dribble through our shifts. And then on a couple of those possessions when they were missing, I think that we didn't come up with enough rebounds. But I just love the physical spirit and fight of the group on the road tonight and they banded together even to get it to a six-point game.

quotes.social_post: Charles Lee praised his teams defensive pressure on Cade Cunningham noting that the star guard had to work for his 30 points throughout the game.

structured.context: Charles Lee evaluates the team's defensive effort against Cade Cunningham and their performance on the boards.
